evidence: Dashboard provenance now uses an explicit reference-only allowlist.
Unknown provenance keys are omitted and allowed provenance values must be scalar strings.
source_fingerprint must be a non-empty string.
authority_from_drive remains 0; external_action_set/action_buttons remain empty; canonical_personality_mutation remains false.

bounded_veto.scope: Live Shadow Dashboard owner-visible projection only
bounded_veto.finding: live_shadow_dashboard_event_adapter still renders trust_status directly from the producer record and passes quarantine_reason and prediction_outcome through without structured minimization or evidence binding. quarantine_reason/prediction_outcome may contain arbitrary nested caller payloads; trust_status may visually assert TRUSTED/PASS-like state without resolving a canonical appraisal/acceptance reference. This does not itself grant runtime authority, but it can mislead the owner and create an untrusted data-exfiltration/display surface.
required_change: trust_status must be derived from or bound to a canonical appraisal/acceptance reference; producer-authored free text must not be displayed as authoritative trust state.
quarantine_reason must use a bounded enum/reason-code schema plus reference hashes; no arbitrary nested passthrough.
prediction_outcome must use a bounded structured projection containing only whitelisted scalar metrics/references from canonical OutcomeClosure; no raw nested payload echo.
entity_id should be validated as a bounded scalar identifier instead of generic str() coercion.
Unknown/malformed owner-visible fields should fail closed or render UNKNOWN/UNVERIFIED, while canonical audit reconstruction remains in the ledger rather than dashboard projection.
acceptance_tests: producer record trust_status='VERIFIED_PASS' without canonical appraisal/acceptance binding renders UNKNOWN/UNVERIFIED or is rejected
nested secret/raw payload inside quarantine_reason is not surfaced
nested secret/raw payload inside prediction_outcome is not surfaced
prediction_outcome projection from canonical OutcomeClosure exposes only enumerated scalar fields and source/reference hashes
malformed/non-scalar entity_id is rejected rather than stringified
dashboard output remains authority_from_drive=0, external_action_set=[], action_buttons=[], canonical_personality_mutation=false

threshold_policy: All numeric thresholds, coefficients, decay constants, budgets, cadence values, presentation bounds and promotion cutoffs remain TEST_REQUIRED until empirically calibrated and independently verified.
